{{Quote|Just another day on the Inte'kepta Way. The Royal Security Forces seem to be more.. forceful lately. Unfortunately, Squad 56-TY was unable to successfully "secure" any freighters or civilian speeders today. It seems the Forces have hired new recruits. They're fresh and bright-eyed. Obviously, they haven't had their high spirits crushed yet. We'll see how excited they are to fly after we, Borvo's thugs, have taken a few of them out.|Bven Ji'ontha|<ref name="SWG:aIR" />}}
'''Bven Ji'ontha''' was a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] employed by the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Borvo]] in the [[Naboo system/Legends|Naboo system]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Ji'ontha commanded the [[Squad 56-TY]] that frequently raided the [[Inte'kepta Way]].<ref name="SWG:aIR" />
{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Bven Ji'ontha was mentioned in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:aIR" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Mention of Bven Ji'ontha was added to the game with the release of the expansion pack [[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed|''Jump to Lightspeed'']] on [[October 27]], [[2004]].<ref name="SWG:aIR" />
